# Limitations

Claims are scoped to Gemma 3 270M, one dictionary and task, and lexical rather
than semantic outcomes. S1 was attribution-selected, so we decompose this
handle, not a unique ontology. S2 often derails; L5/F383 carries its fixed-token
effect but may encode a vowel class, and only four features met the frozen
matched-null rule. S1's leftover overlaps its random control; the switched
subset is descriptive; the twin estimate is small-\(N\); and TV is nonadditive.

The synthetic pair validates estimand polarity, not transformer behavior.
The pre-article patch establishes sensitivity on 12 held-out pairs but is
target-constructed, vocabulary-cued, and subthreshold: private capacity, not a
natural sparse plan. Layer selection uses four development pairs; the
interaction implies no fixed allocation. Finally, \(5\times\) amplification
may be off-manifold; scale, model-family, task, and sampling remain open.
